title: Add 30-degree finite rotation test to TestRigidBodyMotion
objective: Add a finite (30-degree) rotation test to TestRigidBodyMotion in test_benchmarks.py using the reference solver directly, verifying zero internal force after rotation.
scope: Add test_finite_rotation_30_degrees to TestRigidBodyMotion in test_benchmarks.py
Apply 30-degree z-rotation + translation to multi-element mesh
implementation_steps: Read existing TestRigidBodyMotion class in test_benchmarks.py
Add test_finite_rotation_30_degrees using assemble_internal_force from reference solver
Apply R(30deg about z) rotation to all nodes of a multi-element mesh
Assert f_int norm < 1e-12 (SVK in TL gives E=0 for pure rotation)
acceptance_criteria: Test uses multi-element mesh (not single element)
risks: Low risk: physics already verified in test_patch_test.py; adding equivalent to test_benchmarks.py using reference solver API
completion_notes: Tolerance relaxed from 1e-12 to 1e-9 due to reference solver float64 Gauss quadrature roundoff on multi-element mesh (measured: 2.661e-10)
